info.name: CADCraft integration
info.summary: Open and edit DXF and DWG drawings in Nextcloud with CADCraft
info.description:
Open a DXF or DWG drawing in Files with **Edit in CADCraft** and work on it right in the browser, the way you know from AutoCAD: the command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks and layouts.
- **Save** (QSAVE) writes the drawing straight back to Nextcloud in its own format, and Nextcloud keeps the previous state as a file version. - Exports and plots (PDF, PNG, SVG) and saves under another name store a file in any folder you pick. - Read-only files open normally; saving offers a copy. - If someone else changes the file while you have it open, you choose whether to replace their version or save a copy. - Optionally, clicking a DXF or DWG file in Files opens it in CADCraft.
CADCraft runs entirely in your browser as WebAssembly. Files go only between your browser and your Nextcloud, and the server needs no extra software.
This is a community integration based on [CADCraft](https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft) by the ArtCraft team, an open-source, Rust-native drafting app. It embeds a build of CADCraft and is not made or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.
**Requirements:** a browser with WebGPU or WebGL2, and a web server that serves `.wasm` files as `application/wasm` (Nextcloud's own Apache and nginx configurations do).
info.author: Britton Couchman
